public_rationale: On the categorical reading, a pre-existing counterexample contradicts the claim. A December 2022 paper embeds a physical conservation constraint directly in a generative network and enforces it to machine precision. This establishes a way to guarantee a specified physical constraint. It does not establish that Sora can guarantee truthfulness, object persistence, or every physical law. The outcome depends on treating the reference to other generative systems as a broad claim.
limitations: The counterexample concerns incompressible turbulence in a defined domain.
Under a narrower reading requiring unrestricted semantic guarantees for Sora-like video generation, this evidence would leave the claim unresolved.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Sora, like other generative AI systems, has no way to encode and guarantee constraints such as truthfulness or obeying physics.

statement.excerpt: And like other generative AI systems, there is no way to encode (and guarantee) constraints like “be truthful” or “obey the laws of physics”or “don’t just invent (or eliminate) objects”.

from_speaker: there is no way to encode (and guarantee) constraints
our_interpretation: The categorical wording is read as denying that generative systems can encode and guarantee physical or semantic constraints.
A physical conservation constraint enforced by construction in a specified domain counts against that broad denial. Merely improving accuracy or enforcing output syntax does not.
This reading does not require a counterexample to guarantee every physical law or unrestricted truthfulness simultaneously.
The observation concerns methods already available by the post date. Its cumulative availability window has no stated starting date.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes that the generative systems within the claimed scope cannot encode and guarantee constraints of the stated physical or semantic kinds.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A method available by 2024-02-16 embeds a stated physical or semantic constraint into a generative system and guarantees its satisfaction within an explicit domain, rather than merely encouraging it.
